segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown, identifying as the dog that produces the show.

segments.title: Biden COVID Diagnosis & JD Vance Speech Review
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Rick discuss President Biden testing positive for COVID, then watch and react to a 2021 JD Vance speech covering corporate opposition to conservatives, abortion, gender differences, Afghanistan withdrawal, and anti-Semitic tropes about the 2008 financial crisis.

segments.title: Lock Picking, Kissing Tutorial & Line Dancing
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget presents how-to videos: breaking padlocks with nut wrenches, a Spanish-language kissing demonstration between two women, and a country line dance tutorial. Jeb's Dad (trapped in wood) interjects throughout.

segments.title: Post-Jeb Transition & Blazer Shopping Setup
segments.notes: Case thanks Jeb, announces a Jeb dance segment for tomorrow, and begins searching for a new blazer online with chat suggestions while Kendall appears on camera.

segments.title: JD Vance Clone Debate & Blazer Shopping
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether JD Vance is a clone of Case (or vice versa), escalating into 9/11 accusations against Crum. Case shops for wild blazers from Temu/Shein with chat input while Munch claims he's buying coats for the crew.

segments.title: Hard Raid to Gina & Patreon Plug
segments.notes: Case ends the stream early for the Patreon show, raids Gina's channel, and apologizes for not showing Belulia.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the station cold open and countdown as the dog that produces the show.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts the news desk, discusses Biden COVID and JD Vance rhetoric, advocates for de-escalation.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appears on camera during blazer shopping, reacts to Milf Manor drama.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosts How To with Jeb, presents lock-picking, kissing, and line-dance tutorials while his father's spirit interrupts from the wood.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host. Trapped in wood, complains about flies and the wood closing in, critiques Jeb's kissing education.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Crum on JD Vance clone theory, claims he's buying the crew new coats, accuses Crum of doing 9/11.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Counters Munch on clone debate, claims he was apple picking with Munch on 9/11, wins the poll.

storylines.beat: [2024-07-17] Case, Rick, Munch, and Crum debate whether JD Vance is a clone of Case (or vice versa) after Case realizes they look alike; Case has been working out daily since the realization.
[2024-07-17] Munch references buying coats for the crew as a winning gesture; Crum's gambling liability not directly mentioned but his 9/11 apple-picking alibi becomes a running gag.

lore_notes.fact: Case has been working out every day since realizing he looks like JD Vance. [27:06]
Case mentions he is about to move and wonders if internet will improve or worsen. [16:41]
The wood trapping Jeb's Dad is closing in around him daily; flies around his head grow stronger. [49:29]
Munch claims he is buying the entire crew hot new coats after winning a debate poll. [01:05:07]
Crum claims he was apple picking with Munch all day on 9/11 as an alibi against Munch's accusation. [01:13:25]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with Biden's COVID diagnosis before diving into a 2021 JD Vance speech that triggers a resemblance crisis — Case has been working out daily since realizing they look alike. Jeb Nogget presents lock-picking, a Spanish kissing tutorial, and line dancing while his wood-trapped father heckles. Munch and Crum debate the clone theory, escalating into 9/11 accusations, while Case shops for wild blazers from Temu/Shein. The stream ends with a hard raid to Gina for the Patreon show.
